devdoc.details: This contract manages file metadata storage and role-based access control. It allows admins to store file CIDs from IPFS and the owner to manage admins.

getAdmins().details: Returns an array of all current admin addresses. Note: This is a helper for demonstration and can be gas-intensive. In a production environment, you would rely on events.

getFile(uint256).details: Retrieves file metadata by its index.

params._index: The index of the file in the files array.

grantAdmin(address).details: Grants admin privileges to an address. Can only be called by the contract owner.

params._admin: The address to grant admin rights to.

revokeAdmin(address).details: Revokes admin privileges from an address. Can only be called by the contract owner.

params._admin: The address to revoke admin rights from.

storeFile(string,string).details: Stores a file's metadata on the blockchain. Can only be called by an admin.

params._filename: The original name of the file.

totalFiles().details: Returns the total number of files stored.
